== Biography ==

The Footman is a servant posted outside a house in Wonderland, known for his peculiar logic and unflinching composure. When Alice seeks entry, he explains with absurdist reasoning that knocking would make sense only if he stood inside—then he could let her out. He remarks he will sit outside "till tomorrow—or next day, maybe," revealing an indifference to time's passage. When a large plate suddenly flies from the door and grazes his nose before shattering against a tree, he continues speaking in the same tone, entirely unmoved by the incident.
